checks.name: packaged Codex runtime and native helpers match their pinned cryptographic hashes
installed Desktop has a frameless window and no Electron menu
real browser consent completes native Desktop PKCE and a separate native token session
actual Chromium multipart upload and authenticated native stream download preserve the exact owned file bytes
full local access is granted through an explicit warning bound to the selected owned folder
native picker attaches the real canonical local source without uploading its original bytes
real pinned Codex executes on this Windows computer, reads local source, runs a command, writes validated local output and settles actual company-billed usage
actual command and output records start collapsed, open on demand and retain visible exit status
same Desktop task workspace shows its actual bound command output and reads current local result under the active grant
native completed work view has no horizontal overflow or root scrollbar
revoking local permission disables further work and preserves the original completed task
revoked native grant also blocks current-file preview
actual native API/auth requests use the memory-only Chromium session without browser cookies or redirects
